body.text: Admiral Ushakov State Maritime University is one of Russia’s leading maritime universities, training specialists for sea and inland transport, economics, law and engineering.
This section brings together information about the structure, leadership, staff, documents and projects. Mandatory information about the educational organisation is published separately.
